```typescript
export const nextGeneration = (livingCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
  livingCells.filter((cell) => countLivingNeighbors(cell, livingCells) === 3);
```

Note the survival predicate is currently `=== 3` only (survival on 2 neighbors is not yet demanded by any test), so Green should be careful not to break the existing 5 passing tests — in particular "two adjacent living cells die" and "living cell with four neighbors dies".
